summary.intent: Execute Phase 23 (rust-sdk-extraction) which extracts the CipherBox monolithic desktop app into a Cargo workspace with discrete Rust crates (crypto, core, api-client, fuse, sdk).
summary.outcome: Waves 1 and 2 completed successfully (plans 23-01 through 23-03). Wave 3 (23-04 fuse, 23-05 sdk) was interrupted mid-execution by a usage limit reset, leaving partial uncommitted work in both crate directories. Wave 3 was retried at session end but did not complete before the transcript ended.

repo: Phase 23 lives on branch `feat/phase-23-rust-sdk-extraction` — all commits go there.
The Cargo workspace root and `crates/` directory were established in plan 23-01 as the foundational dependency for all subsequent crates.
cipherbox-core extracted 162 desktop tests that continued passing after extraction, plus 12 new crate-level tests.
cipherbox-api-client has 8 source files; 9 shared JSON test vector files were added for cross-language Rust/TypeScript parity.
workflow: GSD wave-based parallel execution: Wave 2 ran 23-02 and 23-03 in parallel successfully.
Pre-wave dependency key-link checks (gsd-tools verify key-links) returned nothing to verify for Wave 3 plans.
When agents are interrupted mid-run (usage limit), crate directories and partial files may exist on disk but uncommitted — re-spawning the same plan agents is the correct recovery path.
Spot-checks after each wave: verify SUMMARY.md exists, check git log for plan-tagged commits, check key created files on disk, and grep for Self-Check: FAILED marker.

friction: Claude usage limit reset mid-wave while Wave 3 agents were running, leaving partial uncommitted work in both `crates/fuse/` and `crates/sdk/` directories.
Neither 23-04 nor 23-05 produced a `lib.rs` or completed their module set before the interruption — fuse was missing most modules, sdk was missing `lib.rs` and `client.rs`.
The Cargo workspace `Cargo.toml` may have been partially updated with the new crates before the interruption, requiring the retry agents to detect and handle existing partial state.
open_items: Wave 3 retry (23-04 cipherbox-fuse, 23-05 cipherbox-sdk) — in progress at transcript end, completion unknown.
